cards.claim: French politician Denis Merville has come forward to disclose his lesser-known profession as an "agriculteurs sur moyenne exploitation".
cards.quote: In a surprising revelation, French politician Denis Merville has come forward to disclose his lesser-known profession as an "agriculteurs sur moyenne exploitation" – a category of farmers who manage medium-sized agricultural operations in France.

cards.claim: Denis Merville is a seasoned French politician.
cards.quote: Denis Merville, a seasoned French politician, had traded in his suit and tie for a more relaxed attire, often donning a beret and a warm smile.
